study: method-v5 real Level-1 reference-domain support diagnostic
current_catalogue_semantics_note: search bounds constrain both candidate centers and the complete native Rayleigh QA window, so a nominal lower bound L effectively excludes centers within about half a Rayleigh window above L

355.interpretation: High-altitude Rayleigh-like windows exist, but the continuous KFS-usable path terminates near 3.0-3.3 km in every block. Lowering the search floor to 6 km cannot make these high windows admissible without bridging a gap.

532.interpretation: Unlike 355 nm, the continuous path commonly reaches 8-10 km. The fixed 10 km domain removes recoverable 532 nm blocks; 8 km recovers five of seven and 6 km recovers all seven under the current catalogue semantics. This does not establish 6 km as a globally valid purity floor.

method_decisions_supported: Keep continuous path admissibility as a hard requirement; do not bridge internal unusable cells.
Do not infer molecular purity from Rayleigh shape alone.
Do not replace the 10 km experimental search floor with a global 6 km floor solely from this case.
Evaluate a support-aware fallback or revised search-domain semantics before promoting method-v5.
